turns.reply: I changed `Console.print()` in `rich/console.py` so that calling it with no objects uses an empty string instead of `NewLine()`, so the `end` argument is now honoured. Calling `print(end='')` now writes nothing, `print()` still writes a newline, and `print(end='X')` writes `X`. The relevant tests in `tests/test_console.py` pass (23 selected). I did not address the "Drop support for Python 3.8" part of the issue title.
